text.KJV: The elder unto the elect lady and her children, whom I love in the truth; and not I only, but also all they that have known the truth;
text.ASV: The elder unto the elect lady and her children, whom I love in truth; and not I only, but also all they that know the truth;
text.WEB: The elder, to the chosen lady and her children, whom I love in truth; and not I only, but also all those who know the truth;

text.KJV: For the truth's sake, which dwelleth in us, and shall be with us for ever.
text.ASV: for the truth's sake which abideth in us, and it shall be with us for ever:
text.WEB: for the truth’s sake, which remains in us, and it will be with us forever:

text.KJV: Grace be with you, mercy, and peace, from God the Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love.
text.ASV: Grace, mercy, peace shall be with us, from God the Father, and from Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love.
text.WEB: Grace, mercy, and peace will be with us, from God the Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love.

text.KJV: I rejoiced greatly that I found of thy children walking in truth, as we have received a commandment from the Father.
text.ASV: I rejoice greatly that I have found `certain' of thy children walking in truth, even as we received commandment from the Father.
text.WEB: I rejoice greatly that I have found some of your children walking in truth, even as we have been commanded by the Father.

text.KJV: And now I beseech thee, lady, not as though I wrote a new commandment unto thee, but that which we had from the beginning, that we love one another.
text.ASV: And now I beseech thee, lady, not as though I wrote to thee a new commandment, but that which we had from the beginning, that we love one another.
text.WEB: Now I beg you, dear lady, not as though I wrote to you a new commandment, but that which we had from the beginning, that we love one another.

text.KJV: And this is love, that we walk after his commandments. This is the commandment, That, as ye have heard from the beginning, ye should walk in it.
text.ASV: And this is love, that we should walk after his commandments. This is the commandment, even as ye heard from the beginning, that ye should walk in it.
text.WEB: This is love, that we should walk according to his commandments. This is the commandment, even as you heard from the beginning, that you should walk in it.

text.KJV: For many deceivers are entered into the world, who confess not that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh. This is a deceiver and an antichrist.
text.ASV: For many deceivers are gone forth into the world, `even' they that confess not that Jesus Christ cometh in the flesh. This is the deceiver and the antichrist.
text.WEB: For many deceivers have gone out into the world, those who don’t confess that Jesus Christ came in the flesh. This is the deceiver and the Antichrist.

text.KJV: Look to yourselves, that we lose not those things which we have wrought, but that we receive a full reward.
text.ASV: Look to yourselves, that ye lose not the things which we have wrought, but that ye receive a full reward.
text.WEB: Watch yourselves, that we don’t lose the things which we have accomplished, but that we receive a full reward.

text.KJV: Whosoever transgresseth, and abideth not in the doctrine of Christ, hath not God. He that abideth in the doctrine of Christ, he hath both the Father and the Son.
text.ASV: Whosoever goeth onward and abideth not in the teaching of Christ, hath not God: he that abideth in the teaching, the same hath both the Father and the Son.
text.WEB: Whoever transgresses and doesn’t remain in the teaching of Christ, doesn’t have God. He who remains in the teaching, the same has both the Father and the Son.

text.KJV: If there come any unto you, and bring not this doctrine, receive him not into your house, neither bid him God speed:
text.ASV: If any one cometh unto you, and bringeth not this teaching, receive him not into `your' house, and give him no greeting:
text.WEB: If anyone comes to you, and doesn’t bring this teaching, don’t receive him into your house, and don’t welcome him,

text.KJV: For he that biddeth him God speed is partaker of his evil deeds.
text.ASV: for he that giveth him greeting partaketh in his evil works.
text.WEB: for he who welcomes him participates in his evil deeds.

text.KJV: Having many things to write unto you, I would not write with paper and ink: but I trust to come unto you, and speak face to face, that our joy may be full.
text.ASV: Having many things to write unto you, I would not `write them' with paper and ink: but I hope to come unto you, and to speak face to face, that your joy may be made full.
text.WEB: Having many things to write to you, I don’t want to do so with paper and ink, but I hope to come to you, and to speak face to face, that our joy may be made full.

text.KJV: The children of thy elect sister greet thee. Amen.
text.ASV: The children of thine elect sister salute thee.
text.WEB: The children of your chosen sister greet you. Amen.
